resources.string: A remote, your favorite streams, and a bigger view of everything you love.
Choose a brand. Connection options depend on your TV model.
What would you like to do first? You can explore everything later.
A little phone. A whole cinema.
Your favorite moments deserve a bigger screen.
The controls you need, right at hand.
Share the moment on a bigger screen.
Sony BRAVIA IP control: enable Remote start and IP control on your TV, set a pre-shared key, and use the same Wi-Fi network. Supported models only.
Direct control for this brand is in development. Use screen sharing or IPTV while we add support.
Unable to connect. Check Wi-Fi, the TV address and network-control settings, and accept the request on the TV if asked.
The TV stopped responding. Reconnect to keep controlling it.
Enter a valid local IPv4 address.

1. Connect phone and TV to the same Wi-Fi. 2. Open the system screen-sharing controls. 3. Select a compatible TV.
Availability depends on your phone and receiver. Protected video may not be shared.
On iPhone, open Control Center → Screen Mirroring and choose an AirPlay receiver.
Screen-sharing settings are not available on this device. Open them from system settings or quick controls.
Add your own M3U playlist or Xtream Codes account. TV Space does not provide channels.
Your next favorite channel starts here.
Cannot read this playlist. Use an M3U/M3U8 playlist that lists HTTP or HTTPS streams.
Cannot play this stream. It may be offline or unsupported.

Pre-shared keys stay in memory for this session. IPTV sources you add, including playlist links and Xtream Codes logins, are saved in this app’s private storage on this device, are never uploaded and are removed when you delete the source. Pairing tokens, TV certificates and Wake-on-LAN addresses are stored encrypted on this device until you choose Forget paired TVs. The last TV name and local address, plus onboarding choices, stay on this device. Network scans run only when you ask. Playlists are provided by you; no bundled channels or account required.
Local network access was denied. Allow nearby-device access in system app settings to connect to your TV.
Connect your TV to start controlling
A better remote, right in your hand.
Bring your own playlist. Keep your favorite channels in one beautiful space.
Paste a playlist link or M3U content below.
Keep your phone and television on the same network.
Select a compatible receiver and enjoy the bigger view.
Receiver support varies. Protected videos may not be shared.
Samsung Smart TV (Tizen): turn the TV on and use the same Wi-Fi. When TV Space asks to connect, choose Allow on the TV screen.
LG webOS TV: turn the TV on and use the same Wi-Fi. When TV Space asks to connect, accept the request on the TV screen.
Check your TV and choose Allow.
Looking for compatible TVs on your network…
No compatible TV answered. Make sure the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi, or enter its IP address.
Or enter the TV IP address
Connect your phone to Wi-Fi to find TVs nearby.
Could not load apps from the TV.
Open a search or text field on the TV, then type here.
Swipe to move. Tap to select.
Drag to move the pointer. Tap to click.
The TV has not shared any apps yet.
Step-by-step guide for playlists, Xtream Codes, files, single streams and the TV guide.
This source lists more channels than the library limit. The first 50,000 were imported.
M3U/M3U8 link from your provider, or paste the playlist text.
Sign in with server, username and password.
Open an .m3u or .m3u8 file saved on this phone.
Watch one HLS or HTTP stream link without importing a playlist.
Add an XMLTV guide to see what is on now and next.
Import channels first, then add a TV guide for them.
HTTP is not encrypted. Others on the network could see this link and any login inside it. Prefer HTTPS when your provider supports it.
Enter the details your IPTV provider gave you. TV Space checks the account with the server before listing channels.
Your login is saved on this device only, so the account stays in your library. It is never uploaded or shared, and deleting the account removes it.
Paste one HTTP or HTTPS stream link, such as an .m3u8 address.
Use an XMLTV guide (.xml or .xml.gz). Programmes are matched to channels by tvg-id or channel name.
Tap + → Playlist URL. Paste the M3U/M3U8 link from your provider (or the playlist text) and tap Import. Large playlists load while they download, and you can cancel at any time.

Tap + → Xtream Codes API. Enter the server address including port, your username and password, or paste the full link from your provider to fill them in. Live channels, movies and series load after the server accepts the account.
Tap + → From device and pick an .m3u or .m3u8 file from Files, Downloads or cloud storage.
Tap + → Play a single stream. Paste one stream link and an optional name. It plays right away and is saved as its own source.

Open a source: the guide your provider offers loads on its own. Tap the TV guide banner to use another XMLTV URL or a file. Channels then show the current programme, time left and what is next, and the channel menu opens the full programme list.
Search by name or group, filter by group, tap the heart for favorites and find what you watched under Continue watching. In the player, use the arrows or the list below the video to switch channels.
TV Space does not provide channels or subscriptions. Only use playlists and streams you are authorized to watch.
Check the server address, username and password.
Cannot load channels from this Xtream server. Check the address and your connection.
The server rejected this account, or the subscription is not active.
Cannot read this file, or it is larger than allowed.
Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS stream link.
Cannot load this TV guide. Use an XMLTV guide whose channels match your playlist.
Cannot download from this link. Check the address and your internet connection, then try again.
Enjoy your remote, mirroring and channels without ads.
No ads anywhere in the app
A new version of TV Space has been downloaded. Install it to get the latest improvements.

Google TV / Android TV: turn the TV on and use the same Wi-Fi. Enter the TV IP address (Settings → Network on the TV), then type the code the TV shows. Buttons only: typing text and listing apps are not available for this TV type yet.
Your TV is showing a 6-character code. Enter it here to pair.
That code does not match. Check the code on the TV and try again.
Wake signal sent. If Wake-on-LAN is enabled on the TV it starts within a few seconds — then tap Connect.
Could not send the wake signal. Check that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
Your sources, favorites and watch history are saved on this device only and are not part of backups.
“%1$s” will be removed from this device together with its favorites, hidden channels and watch history.
Open this playlist in TV Space:
This link contains the username and password of your account. Only share it with people you trust.
Could not update this source. Showing the saved channels.
Channel hidden. Find it under Hidden channels.
Every channel is removed from this list. Your sources are not changed.
This source has no channels saved. Open its details and update it.
No programme information for this channel.
The passcodes did not match. Start again.
Hidden channels are protected by this passcode. It cannot be recovered if you forget it.
“%1$s” from %2$s will be downloaded and saved to your library.
No TV guide is loaded for this source. Tap + to add one.
Notifications are turned off for TV Space. Allow them in system settings to get reminders.
This QR code is not a playlist link.
Point the camera at a playlist QR code shared from TV Space.
Hold the code inside the frame. Nothing is added until you confirm.
Camera access is needed to scan a QR code. Allow it in system settings.
The camera could not be started.
On the other device, open TV Space → IPTV → + → Scan QR code.

Sources stay saved until you delete them. Open the menu on a source to update it, rename it, choose how often it updates or share it. Use the menu on a channel to hide it; hidden channels are behind a passcode. Movies and episodes continue where you stopped.
